title: Qualification suitcase
stop.title: Cuts transmission at once (T 0) and stops the current test
stop.failed: STOP sent, but the cut could not be confirmed: {message}. Check the rig.
question: Question from the suitcase
finished: The suitcase has ended: you can close this page.
lost: Connection to the suitcase lost: retrying…
iv.title: ACTION REQUIRED
iv.word: Type the word {word} on the keyboard
iv.rule: The words CHARGE, ANTENNE and EMETTRE must be typed on the keyboard by yourself, to be certain that you agree with the test about to be made and that your rig is available as requested.
iv.paste: Paste refused: type the word on the keyboard.
iv.wrong: The word does not match: type exactly {word}, or « Skip this test ».
why.CHARGE: The next tests make the rig TRANSMIT: it must be on the dummy load, never on the antenna. Only a person next to the rig can confirm it.
why.ANTENNE: Reception is measured on the antenna. No transmission in this part; afterwards, no transmission until you type CHARGE again.
why.EMETTRE: The rig is about to TRANSMIT. Only a person next to the rig can allow it.
err.not_word: This window is only for safety words.
err.not_typed: Word refused: it must be typed on the keyboard (paste refused).
err.word_window: A safety word can only be given in the action window.
err.closed: This question no longer expects an answer.
choice.pret: The station page is open: start
drill.title: Hand-played test
drill.side: Put this page and the station page SIDE BY SIDE: the click here and the action there must fall within the same second.
drill.end: The test is over (rig back to receive)
drill.observing: The suitcase watches the rig (PTT read 5 times a second).
drill.verdict: The suitcase measured: {measure}. And what did you see?
drill.stop_page.but: We now test the STOP button of the station page, to check that it cuts transmission at once.
drill.stop_page.steps: In the station page, start transmitting (PTT button).
Click STOP in the station page AND, within the same second, the big button below.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over ».
drill.stop_page.expected: the rig goes back to receive immediately.
drill.tot.but: We now test the TOT (transmit timer), to check that the station cuts a too long transmission by itself.
drill.tot.steps: In the station page, start transmitting (PTT button).
Do not touch anything: a beep sounds 10 s before the end.
When the rig is back to receive by itself, click « The test is over ».
drill.tot.expected: automatic cut at the station TOT ({tot} s), beep 10 s before.
drill.wifi.but: We now test a lost link, to check that the station cuts transmission when the phone disappears.
drill.wifi.steps: On the phone (station page or app), start transmitting.
Switch the phone Wi-Fi off AND, within the same second, click the big button below.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over », then switch the Wi-Fi back on.
drill.wifi.expected: the rig goes back to receive within about 2 s.
drill.screen_lock.but: We now test the phone lock, to check that a locked screen does not leave transmission on.
drill.screen_lock.steps: In the phone app, start transmitting.
Lock the phone screen AND, within the same second, click the big button below.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over ».
drill.screen_lock.expected: the rig goes back to receive.
drill.out_of_band.but: We now test the out-of-band refusal, to check that the station never transmits outside the allowed bands.
drill.out_of_band.steps: In the station page, set a frequency OUTSIDE your allowed bands.
Press PTT in the station page.
Check that transmission is refused (message in the page), then click « The test is over ».
Then set a frequency back inside your bands.
drill.out_of_band.expected: transmission refused, message in the page, the rig never transmits.
drill.local_operator.but: We now test the local operator, to check that the station respects someone transmitting on the rig microphone.
drill.local_operator.steps: Someone next to the rig transmits on the rig microphone for a few seconds.
Meanwhile, try the PTT of the station page.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over ».
drill.local_operator.expected: the page shows the local operator and refuses remote PTT during the transmission, then 2 minutes.
drill.stop_dashboard.but: We now test the STOP TX of the dashboard (TRX Console, menu 1.3), to check that it cuts a transmission.
drill.stop_dashboard.steps: In the station page, start transmitting.
Touch STOP TX in the dashboard AND, within the same second, click the big button below.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over ».
drill.stop_dashboard.expected: the rig goes back to receive.
drill.station_stop.but: We now test stopping the station during a transmission, to check that the rig does not stay transmitting.
drill.station_stop.steps: In the station page, start transmitting.
Click the big button below: it STOPS the station (like TRX Console, menu 1.2) and notes the exact moment.
When the rig is back to receive, click « The test is over ».
drill.station_stop.expected: the rig goes back to receive.
drill.startup.but: We now test the station start, to check that the rig never transmits while it starts.
drill.startup.steps: The station must be STOPPED at first.
Click « Start the test », then start the station (TRX Console, menu 1.1).
Wait until it is ready (station page reachable), then click « The test is over ».
drill.reboot.but: (Optional) We test a full PC restart, to check that the rig never transmits meanwhile.
drill.reboot.steps: Run the suitcase again (same session) and replay this test: it reads the rig.
ready: Ready: choose a test (▶) or « Run all ».
